title: Practice 2: Concession in a complex sentence

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Despite her title of Empress of India, Queen Victoria never went there herself.
exercises.ru: ___ свой титул императрицы Индии, королева Виктория сама там никогда не бывала.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I took the dog for a walk even though it was raining.
exercises.ru: ___ на улице шел дождь, я выгулял свою собаку.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Although Gogol was born in Ukraine, he wrote only in Russian.
exercises.ru: ___ Гоголь родился на Украине, писал он только по-русски.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Checkers are played in many different ways, despite their widespread use in all civilized countries.
exercises.ru: В шашки играют по-разному, ___ их широкое распространение во всех цивилизованных странах.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Full respect to Casper for completing the match while clearly ailing.
exercises.ru: Большой респект Касперу, что он закончил матч, ___ проблемы со здоровьем.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It's taken us three weeks to fix, but at last our car runs satisfactorily.
exercises.ru: Мы провозились три недели с починкой машины, но ___ она теперь бегает сносно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom won't be on a diet, even though it is essential for his health.
exercises.ru: Том не сядет на диету, ___ это и критично для его здоровья.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
